project_type: React SPA with Vite bundler and Tailwind CSS v4
test_framework: None configured (no test runner in package.json)
test_command: npm run build (no test runner, use build as verification)
verification_instructions: Run npm run build to confirm no compilation errors. Verify the /notifications route renders with all four tabs.
environment_constraints: No test framework. Verification is build-only. localStorage-based persistence.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns: tab-based page layout, AppContext for state, storage.js helpers for persistence, seed data in src/data/, components in src/components/{module}/, page in src/pages/
key_patterns: Pages use tab navigation with TABS array, icons from lucide-react, AppContext for all state, useCallback update functions that persist to localStorage, seed data uses seededRandom for determinism, Tailwind CSS v4 utility classes, primary color #5B2D8E
directory_structure: src/pages/ has one file per module, src/components/{module}/ has sub-components, src/data/ has seed files, src/lib/ has storage utilities, src/context/ has AppContext
